title: Learning Checklists to Reduce Lottery Effects in Scientific Peer Review
abstract: arXiv:2610.28666v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reviewer lottery error describes error due to a small set of peer reviews attending to only some of the issues with a paper that a larger pool of eligible reviewers would raise. We show this error can be reduced by surfacing a checklist of criticisms learned from a historical review corpus. Our approach generates a tree of checklists representing coarsenings of the atomic review claim space, then selects the coarsening that maximizes a theoretically-motivated measure of correlated agreement among reviewers. We realize this approach with an LLM-assisted pipeline and test it on NeurIPS 2021 and ICLR 2022 review data. In simulated review with LLM reviewers, the learned checklist reduces the mean squared error (MSE) of a three reviewer committee by 58% on NeurIPS and 21% on ICLR, and on both venues the checklist with the highest correlated agreement has the lowest error for committees of three or more. In a human study with 20 participants

translated_title: 学习检查清单以减少科学同行评审中的抽签效应
translated_abstract: 审稿人抽签误差是指由于少量同行评审意见仅关注论文部分问题（而更大的合格审稿人群体本会指出更多问题）而产生的误差。我们证明，通过呈现从历史评审语料库中学习到的批评意见检查清单，可以减少这种误差。我们的方法生成一棵表示原子评审声明空间粗化的检查清单树，然后选择使审稿人之间相关一致性这一具有理论依据的度量最大化的粗化方式。我们通过一个LLM辅助的流程实现了该方法，并在NeurIPS 2021和ICLR 2022的评审数据上进行了测试。在使用LLM审稿人的模拟评审中，学习到的检查清单使三人审稿人委员会的均方误差（MSE）在NeurIPS上降低了58%，在ICLR上降低了21%，并且在两个会议中，具有最高相关一致性的检查清单在三人及以上的委员会中误差最低。在一项有20名参与者的人类研究中
tldr: 该论文提出从历史评审语料中学习批评检查清单（通过生成检查清单树并选择使审稿人相关一致性最大化的粗化方式），以减少同行评审中的审稿人抽签误差，使三人审稿委员会的均方误差在NeurIPS上降低58%、在ICLR上降低21%。
en_tdlr: This paper reduces reviewer lottery error in scientific peer review by learning criticism checklists from historical review corpora—generating a tree of checklist coarsenings and selecting the one that maximizes correlated agreement among reviewers—cutting the MSE of three-reviewer committees by 58% on NeurIPS and 21% on ICLR.
